text:
Jen Park: Quick async check — shipping v2.4.0 tomorrow. Can folks confirm the following before 10:00 UTC so I can cut the release?
- version bump merged to release branch
- changelog entry present
- any flaky tests seen in last 24h?
- CI/build queue healthy or any backpressure?
If you own a failing job, ping here and mark extent. @alex @priya @samir @marco @Morgan (eng-infra)

Alex Gomez: Version bump PR merged to release/v2.4 (package.json -> 2.4.0). Changelog entry added under /changelogs/2.4. One failing check: linux-integration.

CI Bot: [CI Bot] build #8421 for alex-gomez/feat/version-bump failed: test_integration::workflow_timeout — logs: https://ci.internal/8421

Priya Rao: I'll take the linux-integration failure. Re-running now: `ci retry 8421`

CI Bot: [CI Bot] retry triggered by Priya Rao: job #8421 requeued as #8423.

Samir Patel: FYI merge-queue length is 14, integration runners are saturated. Suggest temporary bump of concurrency from 4 -> 6 for the release window. @Morgan (eng-infra) thoughts?

Marco Ortiz: We saw two e2e/session-timeout flakes earlier today. I can triage and pin, but we might want to exempt them for the cut and file follow-ups.

Alex Gomez: Marking my deps update as non-blocking now (label: non-blocking). Container tag currently `rc-2026-03-17` — will retag to final `v2.4.0` after green.

Priya Rao: Job #8423 is green. The retry fixed a timing-related flake in the integration harness. Two e2e flakes remain (tracked in #qa-flakes-2026).

Marco Ortiz: I'll add the two tests to the flaky-exempt list for the release cut and open issues to properly fix them post-release.

Samir Patel: Eng-infra: I can provision 2 extra runners for a 3-hour window to clear the queue. ETA ~20m to spin up. Need confirmation on quota/cost impact.

Morgan (eng-infra): Spinning up 2 runners now, enabling autoscale override until 13:00 UTC. Monitoring queue and runner utilization.

Jen Park: Thanks. Plan: (1) Marco pins/exempts the flaky tests for the cut; (2) only merge critical/blocked PRs (label: release-critical); (3) Alex will retag and I'll cut the release once green. Post any last blockers here — I'll cut at 10:05 UTC if we stay green.

Alex Gomez: One last review pending on prometheus export fix — @samir can you quick-approve? small change.

Samir Patel: LGTM, approving now.

CI Bot: [CI Bot] build #8430 (release-candidate) succeeded on master. All required checks passed.

Jen Park: :tada: Great work. I'll cut release at 10:05 UTC unless anyone sees a blocker. If anything else comes up, reply here so it's captured in the runbook.

Priya Rao: Quick note — I'll follow up with a short postmortem if the e2e flakes reappear after the cut (to avoid regressions).

Marco Ortiz: I'll add follow-up Jira tickets and assign owners.

Alex Gomez: Tagging will happen after the final green, then I'll push release notes.

Jen Park: Closing the loop — thanks everyone.
